subject: [PATCH v2 2/5] memcg: force charges from reclaim before trying the limits

reviews.author: Michal Hocko
reviews.summary:
Reviewer suggested raising the event on all levels that are over, implying that the current patch's logic for raising events is incomplete or incorrect

Reviewer noted that the patch is racy and has additional issues, specifically mentioning that forced charges raise MEMCG_MAX again if already raised before reclaim, and suggested a break to prevent every ancestor at its limit from getting an event.
reviews.raw_body:
This is a separate thing but shouldn't we actually raise the event on
all levels that are over?

---

OK, fair enough. My intention was to have those two parts closer
together but this is not something I would insist.

Acked-by: Michal Hocko <mhocko@sus.com>
Thanks!

-- 
Michal Hocko
SUSE Labs

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch forces memory charges from reclaim operations before checking limits, addressing issues of raised events and margin checks in certain scenarios.
